_: Layer 1 of the design system: everything that is NOT a colour.
Hand-edit this file. Everything downstream — core.css, each set's
tailwind.config.js, each app's global.css, each app's theme/tokens.ts — is
emitted from it by scripts/build-tokens.mjs and must never be edited
directly. Lint check 11 regenerates and diffs, so a hand edit is caught.
TWO SURFACES, ONE SYSTEM.
A 390px phone frame and a 1120px web page do not want the same type scale:
the phone wants fixed px steps, the page wants fluid rem clamps. Forcing
one on the other would be a worse system, not a more unified one. So the
metric scales are per surface and everything that actually causes drift is
shared — the naming rule, the colour key set, the role semantics, the
reserved-block discipline, and the lint that checks all of it.
Provenance is recorded per block. Where sets disagreed, the note says who
won and why, so the next person does not re-litigate it from scratch.

font._: All six token-driven mobile sets declared this identical pair. No mobile app loads a webfont; three declare expo-font and never import it. The web surface adds display/sans/mono via next/font on top of these fallbacks.

_: Geometry is shared across surfaces; tint and strength are per product.
Two geometry families existed on mobile — 14px/34px -10px (aakalan,
askcal, imposter) and 12px/30px -8px (charades, plan-kid) — with
tic-tac-toe on a third. The first wins on count.
A product supplies --shadow-tint as an `r g b` triple and may override
--shadow-a1/a2/a3. A dark product needs a far heavier alpha to read at
all, which is why strength is a variable rather than baked in.
Pinned. Every one of the 572 Tailwind loads and 159 lucide loads in
the tree was unpinned — bare cdn.tailwindcss.com and lucide@latest — so
no design set rendered reproducibly and a CDN release could silently
restyle 452 screens. Lint check 9 enforces these exact URLs.
The canonical colour key set. A palette declaring a key outside this
list, or a ramp stop outside `rampStops`, fails lint check 3.
Only brand-500 is required. Seven-stop ramps are the norm and the
drift page reports completeness, but forcing ten stops would mean
inventing hexes nobody designed — tic-tac-toe genuinely has one.

renamed._: Old name -> canonical name. The lint reports any survivor so a missed rename is visible rather than silently painting nothing.

mobile._: The 390x844 phone frame the wireframes are drawn in, and the Expo apps behind them.

_: The four wireframe steps were byte-identical in all six token-driven
sets — the strongest shared convention in the tree. The product scale
is imposter's, the only app that had one.
Emitting this into every runtime global.css is what makes `text-2xs`
live: it is used 186 times across aakalan, askcal and charades and was
declared in none of them.
tic-tac-toe's h1 was 34px and moves to 36px — two apps had a product
scale and they disagreed on exactly one step.

tracking._: 0.18em, from aakalan / askcal / imposter / tic-tac-toe. charades and plan-kid declared 0.15em in config while hard-coding 0.18em in their own .section-label, so they already contradicted themselves and lose nothing. `role` is imposter's and stays reserved to it.
tracking.label: 0.18em

_: Unanimous except tic-tac-toe's 2xl, which was 28px where every sibling
had 24px — so `rounded-2xl` rendered differently in exactly one app.
`phone` was a token in askcal / charades / plan-kid and a hard-coded
40px inside a media query in aakalan / imposter. Now a token
everywhere. chitragupt and property-app used 32px and move to 40px.

shadow._: Inherits shared.shadowGeometry and adds the desktop frame, which only exists on a wireframe page.

frame._: 390x844 is already the house rule in apps/CLAUDE.md. The desktop breakpoint is where the frame gains its rounded body and drop shadow.

_: ritesh-firodiya.github.io and the other web surfaces. Fluid rem clamps,
not the phone's fixed px — a heading that is 36px on a 390px frame and
36px on a 1440px page is wrong on one of them.
These are the live values already shipping in src/app/globals.css. They
are lifted here unchanged so the site stops being a twelfth system and
becomes the one the others are measured against.

tracking._: 0.14em, not the phone's 0.18em. A label set in a 70rem column needs less air than the same label in a 390px frame.
tracking.label: 0.14em

spacing._: Only ever used as padding. Halved in Sep 2026; the utilities .px-gutter / .py-section wrap them.
